title: drag-lint Graph
summary: This page documents the "View > Tool Windows > drag-lint Graph" menu entry -- the drag-lint graph viewer
intro: Read this when you want the call/reference graph viewer from RAD Studio standard Tool Windows menu. It opens the same window as drag-lint Graph (dockable), served by the IDE plugin, and needs drag_lint_graph.exe deployed beside the plugin.

steps: Choose View > Tool Windows > drag-lint Graph
The graph viewer opens (the same window as drag-lint Graph (dockable)); drag_lint_graph.exe must be deployed beside the plugin

questions.ask: Where is the call/reference graph viewer?
